integrity: Complete proof and executable exact-integer Newton-support checks are provided. Finite checks supplement the general local algebra proof; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only odd prime characteristic and n>=2; the statement concerns the ordinary projective plane model, not every plane embedding; local conductor should not be identified with a global Weierstrass conductor. Equivalent older unindexed treatments remain possible.
title: Two infinity branches and an explicit canonical divisor on maximal automorphism-free plane curves
